name: @mls/cost-ingest
description: Cost Management daily export -> lakehouse cost_daily (L6): a consumption-plan Azure Function, blob-triggered on the cost-export container, that parses the exported CSV, normalises it to the cost_daily shape and replaces the month's partition in OneLake. Managed identity only; no stored credential exists anywhere in the app.
//workspaces: Deliberately NOT a member of the repo-root `workspaces` list, for the same reason apps/directline-token is not: it deploys as its own Azure Functions app with its own dependency closure, and hoisting @azure/functions and @azure/identity into the root tree would put server SDKs in the dependency graph of the browser apps. Install and test it from this directory.

scripts.//test: A GLOB, not a bare directory: `node --test tests/` does not recurse the way the docs imply, and a bare directory argument silently runs nothing here. The .ts sources run directly under Node 22+/24 type stripping, so the suite needs no build and no npm install.
